new_chapters.title: Why covariance must be positive semidefinite
new_chapters.equation: u_y² = aᵀ Σ a, and Σ must be symmetric PSD
new_chapters.limits: Measurement covariance must be estimated from real calibration/control data, currently absent.

new_chapters.title: Inspection guard bands and conditional false acceptance
new_chapters.limits: This probability presumes Gaussian unbiased errors and a specified actual value; no observed error distribution is supplied.

new_chapters.title: Process stability is a prerequisite to capability
new_chapters.limits: Actual stability and distribution are not proved by boolean declarations; outside review remains required.

new_chapters.title: Finite-sample yield is not guaranteed reliability
new_chapters.equation: p_hat=k/n; Wilson 95% lower bound < 1 even when k=n
new_chapters.limits: Wilson confidence requires independent representative observations; no physical trial data are included.

new_chapters.title: An unbroken metrology chain needs real evidence
new_chapters.equation: measurand → instrument → lab reference → SI realization, each with uncertainty
new_chapters.limits: The tool is a metadata integrity audit, not NIST accreditation or a device calibration.

new_chapters.title: Datum frames connect drawings to measured coordinates
new_chapters.limits: A mathematical frame transform is not a physically calibrated CMM or machine-tool coordinate system.

new_chapters.title: A feasible process plan is not an optimal factory schedule
new_chapters.limits: Schedule outputs are not shop-floor safety authorization or throughput forecasts.

new_chapters.title: Mass and energy constraints are reconstruction invariants
new_chapters.limits: Reference energy and mass relationships are not validated machine setpoints or real tool performance.

new_chapters.title: Evidence-carrying process plans refuse unsupported completion
new_chapters.limits: Recorded evidence metadata does not authenticate a lab, physical part or safety control.

new_chapters.title: Manufacturing prerequisites for silicon gates and integrated circuits
new_chapters.limits: Physical fab processes and calibrated device measurements have not been performed.

new_chapters.title: Repairs must regenerate qualification evidence
new_chapters.limits: Maintenance planning is not machine safety certification or control-system functional-safety testing.

new_chapters.title: An auditable chain from physical parts to computing
new_chapters.equation: reconstructible claim = science_reference ∧ manufacturing_evidence ∧ hardware_measurement ∧ verified_computation
new_chapters.limits: No physical reconstructed computer or certified manufacturing facility is part of this release.
